author: FEL (MUSIC-SUITE P9, 2026-09-29)
about: Difficulty 4. The horn hook carries the accents (0.5, the 2.25 / 2.75 pair as an eighth double, the 4.5 / 4.75 sixteenth double); the breakbeat kick on 2.75 in the verses; a freeze on each break bar; free-tap bars every beat in both hooks. Captured breaking in the calls — the KICK STEP in the verses and the HELICOPTER in the second hook dance their captures; the SIDE FREEZE on the second break bar plays the baby freeze. The last hook ends in a FREESTYLE section (bfreeFS: the same free taps, marked) — and, since 2026-10-17, so does the first (the same marked phrase in place of its last free phrase: the same slots, so the steps, the STYLE taps, the cap and a flawless score are unchanged): the buttons pick the move, MATCH is not asked, and it pays STYLE only. Accents, doubles and free taps are STYLE taps; only the moves are scored steps. CAPTURED MOVES (owner 2026-10-17, lane/dance-options): the kick step and the helicopter are spelled as the captures' ids — the same families, beats and accents, so the scored steps, the cap and a flawless NORMAL score are unchanged (HARD's fill moves where a move's length changed). sidefreeze stays the baby freeze: the charts are written around its 2-beat hold.
